title: Limits Involving the Absolute Value Quotient
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

steps.title: Resolve Absolute Value for x > 2
steps.explanation: For inputs to the right of 2, x - 2 is positive, so |x - 2| = x - 2.
steps.why: Definition of absolute value: |u| = u when u > 0.

steps.title: Evaluate Right-Hand Limit
steps.explanation: The ratio reduces identically to 1 for all x > 2.
steps.why: Quotient of identical non-zero quantities equals 1.

steps.title: Resolve Absolute Value for x < 2
steps.explanation: For inputs to the left of 2, x - 2 is negative, so |x - 2| = -(x - 2).
steps.why: Definition of absolute value: |u| = -u when u < 0.

steps.title: Evaluate Left-Hand Limit
steps.explanation: The ratio reduces identically to -1 for all x < 2.
